name: Standard Iron Works Inc
old_description: I’ve been with the company since 1977 and at that time we were using Standard Iron just like we are today. and I know that the company I work for was using it long before then. We have a very good working relationship with ordering the material when we need it and if we order something wrong, they’re very accommodating at getting it picked up and returned. If you’re looking to buy material from Standard iron, I’d say it’s, the one stop.
about:
Standard Iron Works Inc has operated in the Omaha, Nebraska area since 1942. The company began as a small residential steel supplier with three employees and two trucks, gradually expanding into a full-service fabricator serving both commercial and residential markets.

As an AISC Certified Fabricator, the company provides structural steel fabrication, custom metal fabrication, welding, drilling, cutting, bending, stair and railing systems, priming, galvanizing, and rebar processing. It maintains a stock of American-made steel on site and operates a fleet of trucks for rapid delivery, enabling quick turnaround on projects of varying scale. Facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

The firm serves residential and commercial construction sectors, with clients including Hy-Vee grocery stores (notably their largest Midwest retail unit), apartment communities in Florida, and regional home builders such as Duffy Brothers Construction, Echelon Homes, Choice Homes, and Regency Homes/Pacesetter Homes.

Standard Iron emphasizes its AISC certification, quality control processes, competitive pricing, and a reputation for reliability built over more than 80 years as key differentiators.
